items.title: Kings & Queens
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Are you ready to rule the world? Dress like a King or a Queen and now you can!

- 10 royal skins
- By Nitric Concepts

items.title: The Last Dragons
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Embark on a journey to find the last dragons! Explore the island, equip yourself and face these ancient creatures. 
Hatch dragon eggs, tame the monsters and fly with them through the air!

+ Custom survival island
+ Tame and rideable dragon!

items.title: Secret Agents
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
You need security? Here are 12 of our best secret agents, they will be accompanying you on your missions throughout your Minecraft worlds.

- Twelve secret agent skins.
- Two skins totally free.
- Created by DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Ancient Egypt
items.creator: Fall Studios
items.description:
Travel back to the ancient Egypt and learn about the time of the pharaohs!
Explore the pyramid complex, the sphinx and the unfinished obelisk or ride your camel through the oasis and across the fields.

+NPC's that give you interesting information
+By FallStudios

items.title: Adventures
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Start a new adventure today and explore the unknown!
Be an archer, a pirate or just a simple traveler - the choice is all yours.

+ 12 adventurers, starting a new chapter of their journey today!
+ The ultimate adventures are now ready to be started.
+ 1 FREE skin included!

items.title: The Couples Lookbook
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Meet Mallory and Ashley, and their big collection of cute matching outfits!
Whether you're getting ready for bed or prom, winter or autumn, this skin pack contains everything you need to match with the one you love!

- 16 adorable matching skins
- 1 FREE skin: Everyday!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Animal Onesies II
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Revisit your wild side tonight with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Evening fast approaches and you don't want to be too chilly. What else can you do but grab the warmest AND coolest pajamas around? Our new pack is curated to provide you with ten sweet new animal themed PJs to have you looking your best!

items.title: Element Ninjas
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
The elemental ninjas are at war! Pick from one of the 4 clans and represent your inner element! Watch out, things could get dangerous!

- 8 different skins!
- Elemental clan choices are fire, water, earth, and nature!

Which element will you choose?

items.title: DragonFire Skin Pack
items.creator: Spectral Studios
items.description:
The OFFICIAL DragonFire Skin Pack!

Dress up as your favorite dragon from the original DragonFire map experience!

Includes 1 free skin, the Folifalcon.

items.title: Cyberpunk Bikes
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Craft and modify your own cyberpunk bikes. Race in a huge custom world with your friends while collecting new items from "Lucky Blocks" to get epic new vehicles. You don't like the color or the exhaust of your bike? Simply change it with our customization system!

+ 400 bike variants
+ Over 50 custom textures
+ Lucky blocks
+ Multiplayer friendly
+ 2 skins + 2 free skins

items.title: Survival Ships
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
We haven't seen the old pirate here for a long time... He was a great explorer and his ships are full of riches!

- Explore and find gold!
- Hidden chests!
- By 4KS Studios and Street Studios

items.title: Skycubes
items.creator: 4KS Studios
items.description:
Have fun in a new skyblock adventure! These giant cubes of biomes are floating in the sky, filled with resources, and ready for you to adventure in! Travel to each cube, in every dimension, and beat the ender dragon! 

- Mega sky cubes
- Skyblock adventure
- Nether sky cubes
- End sky cubes

By 4KS Studios

items.title: Lunar New Year of the Ox
items.creator: NetEase
items.description: 2021 is the Year of the Ox! This skin pack contains many traditional cultural elements: Tang suit, Hanfu, dragon lion dance characters, and ox in different festive costumes. Come dress up and celebrate Lunar New Year together!

items.title: Among Impostors
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
There are impostors among us! Explore the impostor underground bases and search in the crashed spaceship or alien HQ. Can you find the impostor? Meet animated, suspicious crewmates in spacesuits. Be careful–one of them has a knife!

=> 4 underground bases
=> 4 huge statues with houses inside
=> Play a Whodunit mystery
=> 10 animated crewmates
=> 20 sus skins
=> 1 free skin

items.title: Rome City
items.creator: Kreatik Studios
items.description:
Explore the city of Rome and collect 20 archeological items: a gladiator sword, shield, armor and more! Live your life in Rome city with custom furniture interior and terrain. Roleplay with your friends and discover the Colosseum.

+ Custom 3D weapons and armor
+ Highly detailed city with furniture interiors
+ Singleplayer & Multiplayer 

By Kreatik Studios

items.title: Hunters
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Hunters come from all over the globe to seek the hidden treasures of the world! Knowledge, power, riches, and anything they fancy. What kind of hunter are you?

- 20 roleplay skins!
- Casual modern attire inspired by anime!

items.title: Fantasy Animals
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Roleplay as a fantasy animal! Choose from 1 of over 10 different animals!

+ 10 skins included
+ By Nitric Concepts

items.title: Cyborg Teenz
items.creator: Cleverlike
items.description:
Gear up for the future with Cyborg Teens! Evolution is here, and it's time to upgrade. These skins fuse human style with cybernetic enhancements. Show your friends exactly what you're made of with visible tech, circuits, and metallic parts! Ready to augment your adventure?

Includes one FREE cyberpunk teen skin!

items.title: Lucky Blocks
items.creator: VoxelBlocks
items.description:
Are you feeling fortunate? This factory is full of random lucky blocks waiting to be opened!

+ 440 outcomes
+ A giant factory
+ Custom animations
+ 3 skins
+ Inspired by the original lucky block mod

items.title: Lake Town
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Restore tranquility with the newest release from Shalliquinn's Schematics. Welcome to Lake Town, a formerly peaceful place now left abandoned thanks to the creatures that roam the night. Filled with loot and ripe for the taking, you can take it as your own and form the center of a new world.

items.title: Palace of Time
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Time flies when you're having fun with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Suspended in the air, out of reach except for the bravest of adventurers, lies the Palace of Time. Legends vary regarding its origins and information about what lies inside is non-existent. Will you be the first to risk life and limb to discover its secrets?

items.title: Billionaire Super Mansion
items.creator: VoxelBlocks
items.description:
This billionaire mansion contains everything you could ever dream of!
Enjoy the modern design and the many fully furnished rooms you can explore with your friends.

+ Giant billionaire mansion
+ 20 different rooms
+ Custom textures

items.title: Medieval Castle
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Expand your village or be the king of your kingdom and make yourself comfortable in your castle! But don't forget the harvest! Take your hay to the windmill where you can turn it into bread! Discover this and much more, have fun!

+ Roleplay
+ Village
+ Windmill
+ Castle

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Water World Base
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Start your survival expirations on the Water World Base. The water flooded most of the land of the world. Could you live in this world?

+ 1 free skin 
+ Elevator 
+ Challenge 

Created by Mine-North
